name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1, fueled by late-night broadcasts and a knack for predicting pit stop strategies. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics, before joining a smaller Korean racing outfit. There, he honed his skills in data analysis and race simulation, quickly establishing a reputation for insightful decision-making under pressure. 

At CRG Racing Team, Jae-Hyun is known for his meticulous preparation and data-driven approach. He thrives on identifying subtle advantages and crafting unconventional strategies to maximize performance. His colleagues appreciate his calm demeanor during high-stakes situations and his unwavering commitment to the team's success. Jae-Hyun's perfectionist tendencies often lead him to spend extra hours poring over data, ensuring every possible angle has been considered.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted to the side with a slight wave.
physical.description: He has a serious demeanor with sharp eyes and a thoughtful expression.
